Chapter 583: Chapter 22: Three Hundred Years Later (Please Subscribe)_2

Eight demigods entered Longshan City and infiltrated the Longshan Great Hall.

“Is that Earl Longshan?”

“Just a little fellow over a hundred years old?”

One by one, the demigods hid in the shadows, carefully observing Lin Yuan without making the first move.

Since they had speculated that Lin Yuan might have obtained a divine chance, they had to consider whether he had any trump cards.

Divine chances do not only contain true divine artifacts but also many other means that could seriously injure demigods even after many long years.

...

Therefore, the demigods were all extremely cautious.

The closer they were to success, the more they needed to keep their composure—this was common knowledge to all demigods.

“There shouldn’t be any problems.”

“I haven’t felt any danger.”

“True, I haven’t sensed any aura of an Eighth Layer True God either…”

A few demigods looked at each other, disappointment flickering across their faces.

This meant that the divine chance Lin Yuan had obtained might be very ordinary, not even bringing out a treasure that carried the aura of a true god.

But anyway, even a mosquito’s worth of meat is still meat.

They had come this far and couldn’t possibly return empty-handed.

“Wait a moment.”

Suddenly, a gaunt old man hiding in the shadows slightly changed his expression, looking solemnly at the other seven demigods.

“What kind of strength does Earl Longshan possess?” the gaunt old man immediately asked through transmitted thought.

“What kind of strength?”

“Seems to be Fourth Level?”

“No, it’s Fifth Level.”

The seven demigods immediately responded through thought transmission.

After all, Lin Yuan was right in front of them; they weren’t in a hurry, and the duck in their mouths wouldn’t fly away.

“Whether it’s Fourth Level or Fifth Level, can you all sense Earl Longshan’s strength now?” the gaunt old man asked with a hint of incredulity in his tone.

As he said this.

The faces of the seven demigods changed at once.

For Seventh Rank demigods, whether it was Fourth or Fifth Level didn’t make much difference, and it was practically indistinguishable from First and Second Levels or even ordinary people.

But not making a difference doesn’t mean they were the same.

In the eyes of the eight of them at that moment, Earl Longshan’s aura was hidden, no different from an ordinary person.

For Third or Fourth Level knights, they might feel Earl Longshan to be unfathomable, but all eight here were demigods; how could they not sense Earl Longshan’s specific aura?

“Something’s fishy?”

The gaunt old man’s brow twitched imperceptibly. Although as demigods their premonition and awareness gave no warnings, he just felt that something was off.

“Me too.”

“Shall we withdraw first and then discuss?”

The other demigods also began to think of retreating.

Earl Longshan gave them a very odd feeling.

An odd feeling… that made their hearts tremble.

Just as the eight demigods exchanged glances, planning to leave and make long-term plans,

a gentle voice suddenly rang in their ears.

“Guests have arrived; please stay.”

Under the astonished gaze of the eight demigods, Lin Yuan looked up at them.

“Be careful.”

All eight demigods were on high alert, ready to respond with full force.

The words of Earl Longshan meant that he had discovered them long ago.

But how was that possible? They had been careful enough, and even other demigods might not have been able to detect them.

Could it be that Earl Longshan was also a demigod?

Before the eight demigods could figure it out, a terrifying force from the depths of the void crushed them to smithereens.

In the Longshan Great Hall.

Under Lin Yuan’s gaze.

The eight demigods disintegrated without resistance.

“Thinking of killing me for my opportunity?”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. Since he dared to reveal his Martial Tao Cultivation Skill, he had already taken these possibilities into account; how could he possibly stay in the Longshan Great Hall without sufficient strength?

“Is this the first time I’ve directly killed a demigod?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that although he had killed the Mother Goddess of Lust decades ago, it was a cursed killing from countless miles away without ever having seen her face.

“Hm?”

“This must be the Demigod Lattice?”

Lin Yuan looked at where the eight demigods previously stood. After their physical bodies and souls had completely turned into dust, eight round crystals fell to the ground.

It must be the Demigod Lattice.

In this world, when knights reach the Seventh Rank, they ignite the divine fire and condense the Demigod Lattice. Once they elevate their Divine Kingdom, the Demigod Lattice within them will transform into the Divine Lattice.

Whether it’s a Demigod Lattice or Divine Lattice, both are the absolute core of demigods or true gods, the embodiment of their everything.

Whoosh.

Eight crystals floated in front of Lin Yuan, spinning leisurely.

The crystals were of different colors, emitting different auras, such as the emaciated old man who always hid in the shadows; his Demigod Lattice was the color of shadows with a faint space fluctuation flowing through it.

There was also the figure in the grey robe, whose Divine Lattice appeared grey, undulating with a poisonous aura.

Lin Yuan looked over them casually, grasping the shadowy Demigod Lattice that was emitting the space fluctuations and briefly probed it with his mind.

“Eh!!”

Lin Yuan’s expression changed slightly.

After probing into the Demigod Lattice with his mind, Lin Yuan vaguely obtained the perspective of the Demigod Lattice.

Suddenly, Lin Yuan felt the world had become different.

The world, once filled with various rule fluctuations, now had only space and shadows remaining.

Although only these two remained, in Lin Yuan’s perception, they became extremely clear.

Originally, even in the Main World Prime Universe, with the help of the rich space fluctuations on the Battlefields of Different Races.

Lin Yuan’s perception of the Space Rules was still vague, but now, it was extremely clear.

The many spaces and shadows in this world seemed mystical, especially the vast, slow unfolding of billions of Spatial Layers before Lin Yuan.

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding allows you to observe the essence of the world’s rules, your perception of space and shadows continues to rise…]

…

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding allows you to observe the essence of the world’s rules, your perception of space and shadows continues to rise…]

…

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding allows you to observe the essence of the world’s rules, your perception of space and shadows continues to rise…]

…

Rumbling.

Inner World.

The vast expanse was nearly two hundred million li in radius, and the number of Spatial Layers was nearing three hundred thousand.

Not only that, the number of Spatial Layers in the Inner World was still increasing at a rate of thirty to fifty layers every day.

However.

When Lin Yuan used the Demigod Lattice’s perspective to look at this world and its layers upon layers of space.

The development of Spatial Layers in the Inner World seemed to take a fixed direction, and started skyrocketing.

Thirty to fifty layers a day.

Three hundred to five hundred layers a day.

Three thousand to five thousand layers a day.

Rumbling.

Layer after layer of Spatial Layers developed, making the land of the Inner World become substantial and the sky profound.

“What?” Lin Yuan suddenly opened his eyes, pulling away from the perspective he had just experienced.

“The demigods of this world, their Demigod Lattices are condensed from world rules, which allows them to comprehend the most fundamental rules of heaven and earth?” Lin Yuan was somewhat shocked.

Simply put, the rule-based attack methods controlled by the demigods of this world rely entirely on the Demigod Lattices within their bodies.

With the power of the Demigod Lattice, they unleash the mysteries of rule-based attacks.

“This shadowy space Demigod Lattice could probably allow me to open up a million layers of space…” Lin Yuan’s thoughts converged.

It wasn’t that the Demigod Lattice itself contained the mystery of a million Spatial Layers, but rather, the spatial origin mystery that this Demigod Lattice could glimpse into was that vast.

Seeing and owning are two different concepts.

Lin Yuan was at the Ninth Rank, and with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he was able to exert such an effect with an ordinary Demigod Lattice.

“Against heaven,” Lin Yuan silently marveled, “It’s truly against heaven.”

“If a Demigod Lattice can have such an effect, what about a Divine Lattice?” Lin Yuan’s eyes heated up slightly.

This Demigod Lattice spanned both shadows and space, but only space was of great use to Lin Yuan. Among the other seven Demigod Lattices, there were two more concerning space.

Three Demigod Lattices together, excluding the overlapping essence of space, could open up an additional two million Spatial Layers for Lin Yuan.

One must know that since Lin Yuan stepped into the Ninth Rank, the total number of Spatial Layers was less than three hundred thousand, and this was on the premise of comprehending dozens of Cosmic Forces, more than a dozen higher Cosmic Forces, and one Source-level Cosmic Force.

And now he could directly increase by two million Spatial Layers?

“Demigods?”

“Demigods who have comprehended the space attribute?”

Lin Yuan took a deep breath. Every Demigod Lattice with the space attribute could glimpse into a part of the essence of space, which was greatly useful for Lin Yuan to develop Spatial Layers.

“From now on, both Primordial Spirits will focus on searching for those demigods,” Lin Yuan decided internally. He didn’t harbor a killing intent for those demigods with Spatial Lattices.

As long as the other party cooperated and actively allowed him to sense their internal Demigod Lattices.

Once Lin Yuan finished comprehending, he would only seal them up and release them after the thousand-year living limit had passed.

A thousand years was not significant for the longevity of demigods.

And so.

Time slowly passed by.

In the blink of an eye, three hundred years had passed.
